

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/ToolbarTool.qml

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT {
            function floatSelectSelectionMode(mode) {
            let entry = null
				for (let i = 0; i < editingTools.count; i++) {
					let entryI = editingTools.itemAt(i).item;
					if (entryI.objectName == "selectionButton") {
						entry = entryI;
						/* console.log(entry);*/
						break;
					}
				}
                entry.selectionToolModeSelected(mode);
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/PrimaryPenMenu.qml
	TRAVERSE WritingTool
	LOCATE AFTER ALL
	INSERT {
	property var resetFloatBarPositionFromPrimary
	property var presetSaveFromPrimary
	property int presetNumberFromPrimary: 1
	property var toolSelFromPrimary
	property var colSelFromPrimary
	property var thickSelFromPrimary
	
	property var layersToggled;

	Connections{
		target: root
		function onPresetSave(){presetSaveFromPrimary();}
		function onPresetNumberChanged() {presetNumberFromPrimary = root.presetNumber; }
		function onResetFloatBarPosition(){resetFloatBarPositionFromPrimary();}
		
		function onThickSel(){thickSelFromPrimary();}
		function onToolSel(){toolSelFromPrimary(); }
		function onColSel(){colSelFromPrimary(); }
	}	}
	
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#toolbar > Loader
		REPLACE onSourceUrlChanged WITH {
		onSourceUrlChanged: {
                if (sourceUrl === "") {
                    return;
                }
                const requiredProperties = {
				toolbar : root, 
				antialiasing : root.antialiasing, 
				type : ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton, 
				toolSelFromPrimary: () => {root.toolSel(); },
				thickSelFromPrimary: () => {root.thickSel();},
				colSelFromPrimary: () => {root.colSel(); },
				resetFloatBarPositionFromPrimary: () => {root.resetFloatBarPosition()},
				presetSaveFromPrimary: () => root.presetSave(),
				quickToolsFromPrimary: () => {root.floatbarQuickk=!root.floatbarQuickk;},
				switchPresetsPrimary: () => {root.switchPresets()},
				layerFloatToggle: () => {root.floatbarEnabledLayers = !root.floatbarEnabledLayers},
				};
                setSource(sourceUrl, requiredProperties);
            }		 
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/WritingTool.qml
	TRAVERSE PenTool
	LOCATE BEFORE ALL
	INSERT {
		signal resetFloatBarPosition
		signal presetSave

		signal toolSel
		signal thickSel
		signal colSel

		property var quickToolsFromPrimary
		property var switchPresetsPrimary
	}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE PenTool#root > Item!implicitWidth > ColumnLayout
	LOCATE AFTER ALL
	INSERT {
			ArkControls.FoldoutDivider {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
           }
		QuickToolsToggle {}
	}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE PenTool#root > Item!implicitWidth > RowLayout
	LOCATE AFTER ALL
	INSERT {
			ArkControls.FoldoutDivider {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
           }
		QuickToolsToggle {}
	}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE PenTool#root
	LOCATE AFTER ALL
	INSERT {
	component QuickToolsToggle: ArkControls.Foldout {
        id: quicktools
        antialiasing: root.antialiasing
        Layout.fillWidth: true
		contentItem: ColumnLayout {
						id: content
						spacing: 0
						width: 420
						ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
							label: "QuickTools"
							iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/three_dots_horisontal"
							antialiasing: root.antialiasing
							topDivider: true
							Layout.fillWidth: true
							onClicked: {quickToolsFromPrimary();}
						}
						ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
							id: quickPresets
							label: "Cycle Preset "
							iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/folder"
							antialiasing: root.antialiasing
							topDivider: true
							Layout.fillWidth: true
							onClicked: {switchPresetsPrimary();}
						}
						ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
							id: quickPresetSave
							property string base: "Save Preset"
							property string baseIcon:"qrc:/ark/icons/import"
							property string save: "Saved Preset"
							property string saveIcon:"qrc:/ark/icons/checkmark"
							iconSource: baseIcon
							label: base
							antialiasing: root.antialiasing
							topDivider: true
							Layout.fillWidth: true
							onPressed: {root.presetSave();
							quickPresetSave.label =save;
							quickPresetSave.iconSource=saveIcon;}
							onReleased: {
							quickPresetSave.label =base;
							quickPresetSave.iconSource=baseIcon;}
						}
						ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
							label: "Reset FloatBar"
							iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/arrow_up"
							antialiasing: root.antialiasing
							topDivider: true
							Layout.fillWidth: true
							onClicked: {root.resetFloatBarPosition()}
						}
    }
	}
	}
	END TRAVERSE
		TRAVERSE PenTool
		TRAVERSE FoldoutGrid:PenGrid > Repeater#toolsRepeater > ArkControls.FoldoutItem
			LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT
			{
			onPressAndHold: {root.toolSel(); }
			}
		END TRAVERSE

		TRAVERSE FoldoutGrid:ThicknessGrid > Repeater > ArkControls.FoldoutItem
			LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT
			{
			onPressAndHold:{root.thickSel(); }
			}
		END TRAVERSE

		TRAVERSE FoldoutGrid:ColorGrid > Repeater  > ArkControls.FoldoutGridItem
			LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT
			{
			onPressAndHold: {root.colSel(); }
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT {
            function selectFloatEraser(input) {
			    let entry = null;
				for (let i = 0; i < editingTools.count; i++) {
					let entryI = editingTools.itemAt(i).item;
					if (entryI.penToolType == "eraser") {
						entry = entryI;
						/* console.log(entry);*/
						break;
					}
				}
				root.eraserToolSelected(input);
				requestPenSelect(entry, 0);


            }
			function switchPresets(){
				root.presetNumber = (root.presetNumber == 3) ? 1 : (root.presetNumber == 2 ? 3 : 2)	
			}
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
	IMPORT ark.tokens 1.0 ArkTokens
	IMPORT QtQuick.Controls 2.15
	IMPORT QtQuick.Layouts 2.15
	TRAVERSE FocusScope
		LOCATE AFTER id
		INSERT {
			property bool shouldAnchorL: false
			property bool shouldAnchorLayers: false
			property bool timeOutBeforeMoving: false
			property bool timeOutBeforeMovingTools: false
			property bool collapsed:true
		    property bool isQuickPenSelected: false
		}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#_uiContainer
		TRAVERSE Toolbar
		REPLACE onSelectionToolModeSelected WITH{

            onSelectionToolModeSelected: (mode) => {
                root.selectionToolMode = mode;
                toolbar.currentSelectionMode = mode;
            }
		}
		END TRAVERSE
		TRAVERSE Toolbar
			LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT {

				onLayersToggled: () => { toolbar.floatbarEnabledLayers = !toolbar.floatbarEnabledLayers}
				
				onResetFloatBarPosition: () => {
					layers.moveToPosition((parent.width-layers.width)/2,floatQuick.height);
				floatQuick.moveToPosition(ToolBar.x+ToolBar.width, 0);
				}
				onPresetSave: () => {floatQuick.saveQuickToolFile()}
				onToolSel: () => { floatQuick.addNewToolOnly("Tool", documentViewTools.activePen.tool);

				}

				onColSel: () => { floatQuick.addNewColourOnly("Colour", documentViewTools.activePen.colorCode, documentViewTools.activePen.color);

				}
				onThickSel: () => { floatQuick.addNewThickOnly("Thick", documentViewTools.activePen.thickness);

				}
				onFloatAddRedo: () => {floatQuick.addNewToolPlus("Redo", 91, 0, 0) }
				onFloatAddUndo: () => {floatQuick.addNewToolPlus("Undo", 90, 0,0) }
				onFloatToolSel: () => {

				if (isQuickPenSelected){
					floatQuick.quickTool = floatQuick.quickTool.filter(
							function(item) {
									if(documentViewTools.isWritingTool(item.tool)){
										return !(
											item.tool      == documentViewTools.activePen.tool &&
											item.rgb       == documentViewTools.activePen.colorCode &&
											item.paletteEnum == documentViewTools.activePen.color &&
											item.thickness == documentViewTools.activePen.thickness
										)
									}

									else{
										var baseMatch =
											item.tool      == documentViewTools.activePen.tool &&
											item.type      == documentViewTools.activeTool &&
											item.thickness == documentViewTools.activePen.thickness;

										if (item.tool == 11) {

											return !(baseMatch && item.capture == root.selectionToolMode);
										}

										return !baseMatch;
									}


											})
											floatQuick.saveQuickToolFile();
						}
				else{
						if (documentViewTools.isWritingTool(documentViewTools.activePen.tool)){
						

						floatQuick.addNewTool(documentViewTools.activeTool, documentViewTools.activePen.tool,documentViewTools.activePen.colorCode,documentViewTools.activePen.color, documentViewTools.activePen.thickness, root.selectionToolMode);
						floatQuick.saveQuickToolFile();
						} 
						else {

							floatQuick.addNewToolPlus(documentViewTools.activeTool, documentViewTools.activePen.tool,documentViewTools.activePen.thickness, root.selectionToolMode);
						}
				}
				
				
				}
			}
		END TRAVERSE
		LOCATE AFTER Toolbar
		INSERT {

	ToolTip {
        id: floatBarTips
		type: ArkTokens.Tooltip.secondary
        parent: pointTo.parent
        readonly property int tooltipMargin: 112
        container: Qt.rect(formatMenuDelegate.x + tooltipMargin, formatMenuDelegate.y + tooltipMargin, formatMenuDelegate.width - tooltipMargin * 2, formatMenuDelegate.height - tooltipMargin * 2)

        caption: qsTr("Floating Toolbar")
	description: qsTr("Go to https://github.com/FouzR/xovi-extensions on instructions")
        closeButtonFocusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
        pointTo: floatQuick
        positionHint: ArkControls.Tooltip.Position.Right
        horizontalAlignment: ArkControls.Tooltip.Position.Left
        OnboardingStateProp.key: "FloatingToolbarOnboarding"
        readyToShow: floatQuick.visible
	QRCodeProvider {
                        id: floatingGithubProvider
                        text: "https://github.com/FouzR/xovi-extensions"
                    }

                    Image {
                        id: qrcodeFloat
						width: 80
						height: 80
						anchors.right: parent.right
						anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
						anchors.margins: 8
                        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
                        source: floatingGithubProvider.imageUrl
                    }
    	}
			ArkControls.ContextualMenu{
				id: layers
				property bool currentFile: sceneView.notePage || sceneView.document
				onCurrentFileChanged: floatQuick.loadQuickToolFile();
				visible: currentFile && toolbar.floatbarEnabledLayers
				scale: 1 
				uniformSize: false
				Drag.active: floatLayerHandle.drag.active
				anchors.top: documentView.shouldAnchorL ? floatQuick.bottom : undefined
				anchors.left: documentView.shouldAnchorL ? floatQuick.left : undefined                
				property real originalX
				property real originalY
				function moveToPosition(newX, newY) {
					x = newX
					y = newY
				}
				ColumnLayout{
				rotation: 180
				spacing: 0
				Repeater{
					model: sceneLayersModel
					Row{
						rotation: 180
						required property int layerIndex
						required property string layerName
						required property bool layerVisible
						required property bool layerSelected
						required property bool layerMoveUpEnabled
						required property bool layerMoveDownEnabled
						required property bool layerMergeEnabled
						required property bool layerTrashEnabled
						ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
							visible: collapsed
							
							focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
							type: layers.type

							Text
							{
							font.family: "Helvetica"
									horizontalAlignment:  Text.AlignHCenter 
									verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter 
									style: Text.Outline
									visible: !layerSelected
									styleColor: "white"
									anchors.fill: parent 

									font.pointSize: 30
									text: layerIndex+1
								}
							

							selected: layerSelected
							Text
							{
							font.family: "Helvetica"
									horizontalAlignment:  Text.AlignHCenter 
									verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter 
									color: "white"
									visible: layerSelected
									anchors.fill: parent 
									font.pointSize: 30
									text: layerIndex+1
								}
							
							onClicked: () => {sceneController.setCurrentLayer(layerIndex);}
							onPressAndHold: () => {tempTextField.visible = true}
							onReleased: () => {tempTextField.visible = false}
							Rectangle{
								color: "white"
								anchors {
										right: parent.left
										verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
									}
									border.color : "black"
									border.width: 5
								visible: tempTextField.visible
								width: tempTextField.width+30 
								height: parent.height
								antialiasing: false
							}
							Text{
								id: tempTextField
								visible: false
								anchors {
									right: parent.left
									rightMargin: 15
									verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
								}
								font.pointSize: 26
								text: layerName
							}
							Rectangle {
									anchors.fill: parent
									color: "white"
									visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
							}
						}
						ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
							visible: collapsed
							focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
							type: layers.type
							selected: layerSelected
							iconSource: layerVisible?"qrc:/ark/icons/eye" : "qrc:/ark/icons/eye_closed" 
							onClicked: () => {sceneController.setLayerVisible(layerIndex, !sceneController.isLayerVisible(layerIndex)); }
						}
						ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
							visible: collapsed
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
							focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
							type: layers.type
							iconSource: layerMoveUpEnabled ?"qrc:/ark/icons/arrow_up":"qrc:/ark/icons/x_large"
							onClicked: () => {sceneController.moveLayer(layerIndex, layerIndex + 1);}
						}
						ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
							visible: collapsed
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
							focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
							type: layers.type
							iconSource: layerMoveDownEnabled ?"qrc:/ark/icons/arrow_down":"qrc:/ark/icons/x_large"
							onClicked: () => {sceneController.moveLayer(layerIndex, layerIndex - 1);}
						}
						
						ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
							visible: collapsed
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
							focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
							type: layers.type
							iconSource: layerMergeEnabled ?"qrc:/ark/icons/merge" : "qrc:/ark/icons/x_large" 
							onClicked: () => {if (layerMergeEnabled){sceneController.mergeLayerDown(layerIndex);}}
						}
						ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
							visible: collapsed
							focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
							type: layers.type
							iconSource: layerTrashEnabled ?"qrc:/ark/icons/trashcan" :"qrc:/ark/icons/trashcan_delete"  
							onClicked: () => {if (layerTrashEnabled){sceneController.deleteLayer(layerIndex);}}
						}
					}
				}
				Row{
				rotation: 180
				ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
					id: floatLayerHandleParent
					focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					type: layers.type			
					onPressAndHold: () => {timeOutBeforeMoving = !timeOutBeforeMoving}
					iconSource: collapsed ? "qrc:/ark/icons/multicolor/toolbar_show" : "qrc:/ark/icons/toolbar_hide"
					MouseArea {
						id: floatLayerHandle
						anchors.fill: parent
						drag.target: layers
						onPressAndHold: () => {collapsed = !collapsed}
						onPressed: () => {pageSlider.requestMono = true;layers.originalX = layers.x;
						layers.originalY = layers.y;
						timeOutBeforeMoving = true;
						}
						property int snapThreshold: 30
						onReleased: () => {pageSlider.requestMono = false;timeOutBeforeMoving=false;}
						onPositionChanged: {
							if (drag.active) {
								var centerX = layers.x + layers.width / 2
								var centerY = layers.y + layers.height / 2
								if (Math.abs(layers.x) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.x = 0
								}
								else if (Math.abs(layers.x + layers.width - root.width) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.x = root.width - layers.width
								}
								else if (Math.abs(centerX - root.width / 2) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.x = root.width / 2 - layers.width / 2
								}
								if (Math.abs(layers.y) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.y = 0
								}
								else if (Math.abs(layers.y + layers.height - root.height) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.y = root.height - layers.height
								}
								else if (Math.abs(centerY - root.height / 2) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.y = root.height / 2 - layers.height / 2
								}
								if (Math.abs(layers.x) < snapThreshold && 
									Math.abs(layers.y) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.x = 0
									layers.y = 0
								}
								else if (Math.abs(layers.x + layers.width - root.width) < snapThreshold && 
										 Math.abs(layers.y) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.x = root.width - layers.width
									layers.y = 0
								}
								else if (Math.abs(layers.x) < snapThreshold && 
										 Math.abs(layers.y + layers.height - root.height) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.x = 0
									layers.y = root.height - layers.height
								}
								else if (Math.abs(layers.x + layers.width - root.width) < snapThreshold && 
										 Math.abs(layers.y + layers.height - root.height) < snapThreshold) {
									layers.x = root.width - layers.width
									layers.y = root.height - layers.height
								}
							}
						}
					}							
				}
				ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
					visible: collapsed
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
					focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					type: layers.type
					iconSource: sceneController.backgroundVisible?"qrc:/ark/icons/eye" : "qrc:/ark/icons/eye_closed" 
					onClicked: () => {sceneController.setBackgroundVisible(!sceneController.backgroundVisible);}
				}
				ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
					id: floatbarNewPage
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
					visible: collapsed
					focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					type: layers.type
					iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/page_add"
					onClicked: () => {
					root.addPage(document);
                root.reportPageAdded(root.document, "floating button");
                }
				}
				ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button{
					id: layerMenuOpen
					Rectangle {
							anchors.fill: parent
							color: "white"
							visible: timeOutBeforeMoving
					}
					visible: collapsed
					focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					type: layers.type
					iconSource: sceneLayersModel.count==5?"qrc:/ark/icons/warning_circle": "qrc:/ark/icons/plus_circle"
					onClicked: () => {sceneController.addLayer();}
				}

				function addNewTool( toolType, toolId, toolRGB, toolPalette,toolThickness, selCapture) {
					quickTool.push({
						type: toolType,
						tool: toolId,
						rgb: toolRGB,
						paletteEnum: toolPalette,
						thickness: toolThickness,
						capture: selCapture
					})
					quickToolChanged()
				}
				function addNewToolPlus( toolType, toolId, toolThickness, toolCapture) {
					quickTool.push({
						type: toolType,
						tool: toolId,
						thickness: toolThickness,
						capture: toolCapture
					})
					quickToolChanged()
				}

					quickTool.push({
						type: toolType,
						tool: toolId,
					})
					quickToolChanged()
				}

				function addNewColourOnly(toolType, toolRGB, toolPalette){
					quickTool.push({
						type: toolType,
						rgb: toolRGB,
						paletteEnum: toolPalette
					})
					quickToolChanged()
				}

				function addNewThickOnly(toolType, toolThickness){
					quickTool.push({
						type: toolType,
						thickness: toolThickness,
					})
					quickToolChanged()
				}
				function moveQuickTool(fromIndex, toIndex) {
					if (fromIndex < 0 || fromIndex >= quickTool.length || 
						toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= quickTool.length) {
						return false;
					}
					const toolToMove = quickTool.splice(fromIndex, 1)[0];
					quickTool.splice(toIndex, 0, toolToMove);
					quickToolChanged();
					return true;
				}
				function saveQuickToolFile() {
					let xhr =                                       new                                      XMLHttpRequest();
					let data = {
						quickTool: quickTool,
						isfloatQuickActive: toolbar.floatbarQuickk,
						isLayersActive: toolbar.floatbarEnabledLayers,
						layersPositionX: Math.abs((layers.x-root.width)/root.width),
						layersPositionY: Math.abs((layers.y-root.height)/root.height),
						quickPositionX: Math.abs((floatQuick.x-root.width)/root.width),
						quickPositionY: Math.abs((floatQuick.y-root.height)/root.height)
					};
					let dataStr = JSON.stringify(data);
					if (presetState === 1){
					xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/quickTool.json");}
					else if (presetState === 2){
					xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/quickTool2.json");}
					else {xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/quickTool3.json");}
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
							console.log("Save completed");
						}
					};
					xhr.send(dataStr);
				}
				function loadQuickToolFile() {
					let xhr =                                                                         new                                                                         XMLHttpRequest();
					if (presetState===1){
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/quickTool.json");}
					else if (presetState===2){
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/quickTool2.json");}
					else {xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/quickTool3.json");}
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
							try {
								let data = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
								quickTool = data.quickTool || [];
								toolbar.floatbarQuickk = data.isfloatQuickActive !== undefined ? data.isfloatQuickActive : false;
								toolbar.floatbarEnabledLayers = data.isLayersActive !== undefined ? data.isLayersActive : false;
								floatQuick.x = data.quickPositionX !== undefined ? ((1-data.quickPositionX)*root.width ) : 0;
								floatQuick.y = data.quickPositionY !== undefined ? ((1-data.quickPositionY)*root.height) : 0;
								layers.x = data.layersPositionX !== undefined ? ((1- data.layersPositionX)*root.width) : 0;
								layers.y = data.layersPositionY !== undefined ? ((1- data.layersPositionY)*root.height) : 0;
							} catch (e) {
								console.error("Failed to parse file:", e);
								quickTool = [];
								toolbar.onboarded = false;
							}
						}
					};
					xhr.send();
				}
				Component.onCompleted: {
					loadQuickToolFile();

				}
				onPresetStateChanged: {loadQuickToolFile();}
